title: Network-error screen: both 'Réessayer' and 'Appeler le personnel' buttons are dead (emit-only, no listener, no router fallback)

evidence: retry() does `this.$emit('retry')` and callStaff() does `this.$emit('call-staff')` with NO $router fallback. title: OSS auto-scroll translateY(-50%) hides bottom of queue at high volume — customer near end never sees N° go PRÊT
anchor: resources/js/components/admin/orderStatusScreen/PreparingAndReadyComponent.vue:486-494 (oss-autoscroll keyframe) + backend feed uncapped at app/Services/OrderStatusScreenOrderService.php:146 (->get(), no limit)
abuse_condition: Busy lunch/dinner service: 20-40 active PREPARING+PREPARED orders on the wall (high-volume), small/standard TV viewport
evidence: The column is `overflow-hidden` (line 23/52) and the list animates only via `@keyframes oss-scroll-loop { 90% { transform: translateY(-50%) } }` (line 489-494). translateY(-50%) shifts the list up by exactly half of its OWN height — it fully reveals the bottom only when the list is ~2x the container height. The backend OSS query returns ALL active rows with no limit/take (OrderStatusScreenOrderService.php:146 `return $query->get();`, statuses PREPARING+PREPARED line 63), so the list can be 3-4x container height. At that size -50% reveals only the middle band; items below ~50% of the list height never enter the viewport across the whole 30s loop. A customer whose ticket is near the end of the queue literally never sees it transition to PRÊT — the wall silently lies about their order's readiness. A fiscal test (NF525 chain) never exercises this.
recommendation: Make the auto-scroll travel the real overflow distance, not a fixed -50%: compute translateY in JS as -(scrollHeight - clientHeight) for the column (or use a marquee that loops the full content height), OR cap the rendered rows to what fits + a '+N en attente' counter. Until fixed, a hard frontend slice with an overflow indicator is safer than a scroll that strands the tail.

anchor: resources/js/components/admin/kitchenDisplaySystem/KdsOrderCard.vue:320-324 (cardStyle height:'462px') vs resources/js/components/admin/kitchenDisplaySystem/KdsV2Grid.vue:421-429 (grid-template-rows: repeat(2, minmax(0,1fr)))

The card already has internal `overflow:auto` body scroll, so it does not need a fixed outer height.

title: Quantity input has no upper bound and accepts pasted/typed values — '999' (or larger) silently multiplies the cart subtotal
anchor: FrontendCartComponent.vue:73-75 (input type=number, @keyup quantityUp) -> :173-176 quantityUp only guards `e.target.value > 0`; store mutation frontendCart.js:163-165 sets quantity = payload.status with no cap; subtotal mutation :142-149 multiplies blindly. onlyNumber (appService.js:57-63) blocks non-digit keypresses but NOT paste.

The rendered subtotal/total become unbounded and a string-typed quantity could even concatenate in edge paths.
recommendation: Add max/maxlength to the input and clamp in quantityUp (e.g. 1..99) before dispatch; coerce to integer. Backend pricing still re-validates, but the customer should never see a runaway subtotal.

title: pos-wizard.css/.js cache-busted with per-request `{{ time() }}` — defeats browser caching on every full page load

title: Systemic Vue `:key="<object>"` anti-pattern in 20+ list components forces full remount on every data refresh
anchor: resources/js/components/admin/salesReport/SalesReportListComponent.vue:193 (`v-for="salesReport in salesReports" :key="salesReport"`); same object-as-key in posOrders/PosOrderListComponent.vue:99, onlineOrders/OnlineOrderListComponent.vue:105, items/ItemListComponent.vue:202, tableOrders/TableOrderListComponent.vue:102, customers/CustomerListComponent.vue:86, +14 others

anchor: resources/js/store/modules/kioskCart.js:225-253 (subtotal getter sums raw (base+varExtra+extras)*qty unrounded; total = subtotal - discounts) vs per-line item.total rounded via toFixed(2) at lines 271, 286, 309, 331
evidence: The `subtotal` getter (L225-231) accumulates `(parseFloat(convert_price)+item_variation_total+item_extra_total)*quantity` as a raw float with NO per-line rounding, and `total` (L250-253) subtracts discounts from it. But each cart line's displayed `item.total` IS rounded per line: `parseFloat(((base+varE+ext)*qty).toFixed(2))` (ADD_ITEM L271, normalizeItem L286, L309, qty-change L331). For any unit price with sub-cent precision (or many lines), the sum of the rounded line totals the customer reads can differ from the unrounded footer total by one or more cents — the classic 'lines don't add up to the total'. Contrast POS posCart.js:484-491 which sums `computePosCartLineDisplayTotal(line)` per line, so its subtotal == sum of visible line totals (no drift). The server (PricingService) is SSOT for the CHARGED amount, so the bill is correct — but the on-screen total can disagree with both the line sum and the charged amount.
recommendation: Compute the kiosk `subtotal` getter as the sum of the already-rounded per-line `item.total` (mirror posCart.js), or round each line term inside the reduce, so the displayed footer total equals the visible sum of line totals.
abuse_condition: Multiple lines and/or unit prices that aren't clean to 2 decimals (variations/extras), large quantities (up to MAX_ITEM_QTY).

surface: Admin Dashboard — Overview ('Vue d'ensemble') vs Sales Summary vs Order Statistics

surface: Admin — Sales Report (Rapport des ventes) summary cards
title: Sales-report overview mixes bases: total_orders counts refund-mirror entries that total_earnings nets out, and disagrees with the dashboard's mirror-excluding count
anchor: app/Services/OrderService.php:2804-2808 (total_orders = $orders->count(); total_earnings/discounts/charges = paidOrders net set via Order::isRealizedRevenueRow) vs DashboardService.php:366 (count uses whereNull('parent_order_id'))
evidence: In salesReportOverview, `total_orders = $orders->count()` counts the full filtered set INCLUDING refund counter-entry mirrors (parent_order_id set), while `total_earnings`, `total_discounts`, `total_delivery_charges` use `$paidOrders = $orders->filter(isRealizedRevenueRow)` which INCLUDES the negative mirror for money but represents a different population. The table rows below also list mirror rows (negative total_amount_price) with no exclusion, so a refunded order shows up as two rows.
recommendation: Exclude refund mirrors from total_orders (whereNull('parent_order_id')) for parity with the dashboard, and decide whether mirror rows should appear in the table; document the chosen 'placed-volume' definition once and apply it on every count surface.
abuse_condition: Any period containing a refund (RETURNED order with parent_order_id).

surface: Borne/Kiosk — order confirmation screen (points fidélité gagnés)
title: Kiosk shows loyalty points 'earned' at confirmation, but points are only awarded OnDelivery — a cancelled/refunded order displays points the client never keeps
anchor: resources/js/components/frontend/kiosk/KioskConfirmationComponent.vue:207-213 (pointsEarned = Math.floor(total*rate), client-side) vs app/Listeners/AwardLoyaltyPointsOnDelivery.php:84,98-102 (awarded only on the delivered/realized event)
evidence: pointsEarned (L208-213) is computed client-side as `Math.floor(_snapshotOrderTotal * rate)` using `lists.loyalty_points_per_euro`, and rendered as 'vous avez gagné N points' (L60, L131) immediately on the confirmation screen. The actual award happens server-side in AwardLoyaltyPointsOnDelivery (`$pointsToAward = floor($orderTotal * $rate)` on order->total, L98-102), fired on delivery/realization, and is clawed back on refund (ClawbackLoyaltyPointsOnRefund exists). The base/formula match (order->total, floor, rate), so the NUMBER is right at confirmation — but the TIMING claim is wrong: a kiosk order that is later cancelled, rejected, or refunded showed the client a points gain that is never actually credited (or is clawed back). The displayed number is a promise the system may not keep.
recommendation: Either phrase it as conditional ('vous gagnerez N points à la remise de la commande') or only surface points after the award event; keep the floor(total*rate) formula and rate fallback (|| 0) as-is.
abuse_condition: Order cancelled/refunded after confirmation; rate setting changes between display and award.

surface: POS Caisse — loyalty redeem modal (aperçu de la remise)
title: Loyalty redeem 'preview discount' is a client-side estimate from a prop rate; if the prop diverges from the server rate the cashier briefly sees a wrong euro figure (overwritten on apply)

title: Transient WS-loss banner is silent on the box: cashier sees stale orders with NO 'reconnexion' cue while KDS does warn
anchor: resources/js/components/admin/pos/PosOrdersTrackerComponent.vue:10 (suppress-transient suppress-session-invalid) + :97 (v-if="!realtimeConnected && !isDevEnv") ; resources/js/components/common/ConnectionStatusBanner.vue:73-90 (isDevEnv gate hides transient banner in local/testing) ; config/kds.php:35 ("the real Le Cayenne box runs APP_ENV=local")
evidence: ConnectionStatusBanner.visible() returns false when isDevEnv (env==='local'||'testing') for the transient reconnecting/offline path (line 89); session-invalid still renders (line 86). On the POS tracker the common banner is mounted with BOTH suppress-transient AND suppress-session-invalid (line 10) so it renders nothing, and its inline replacement pos-tracker-rt-warn is gated `!realtimeConnected && !isDevEnv` (line 97). Since the box runs APP_ENV=local, when soketi/WS drops the cashier gets ZERO connection cue and the kanban silently coasts on the 8s polling fallback (POLL_NO_WS_MS=8000, :426) — orders look fresh but are up to 8s stale, and any push-only freshness (e.g. _markFresh PRÉPARÉ flash) silently stops. On the local-env box the cashier MUST see a 'Mode hors-ligne — actualisation lente' cue when realtimeConnected is false, exactly as the kitchen does.
abuse_condition: soketi/queue worker dies mid-service (or WS port 6001 unreachable) — the documented degradation path in SYNC_CONTRACT §7

surface: OSS public customer wall + authed staff OSS + Kiosk shell
title: Transient connection banner suppressed on every non-KDS surface (suppress-transient everywhere) → silent staleness on the box

title: Offline-queued borne order shows a forever-spinner: customer never sees success, real queue number, or failure
anchor: resources/js/components/frontend/kiosk/KioskWaitingComponent.vue:244-249 (mounted early-returns for offline_ ids: sets isOfflineOrder=true, NO subscribe, NO poll) + :10-21 (permanent spinner template) ; resources/js/components/frontend/kiosk/KioskAppComponent.vue:340-347 (syncCb only updates offlinePending/offlineAbandoned counts, never re-routes the waiting screen) ; resources/js/helpers/kioskOfflineQueue.js:556-560 (replay succeeds + _track('offline.replayed') but no UI handoff)
evidence: When the borne is offline at checkout, the order is queued with an `offline_*` synthetic id and the customer is sent to kiosk.waiting. mounted() detects the offline_ prefix, sets isOfflineOrder=true and RETURNS immediately — it never subscribes to Echo, never polls, and never listens to the offline-queue's onSync/recovery callback. The queue DOES replay correctly when network returns (syncQueue, kioskOfflineQueue.js:550-560 — no data loss), but the waiting screen has no path to learn that: the spinner (lines 11-20) spins indefinitely until the global idle-reset timer (KioskAppComponent idle logic) eventually bounces to idle. The customer is left staring at '📡 ... en cours' with no confirmed queue number and no success/abandon outcome (MAX_ATTEMPTS abandon at kioskOfflineQueue.js:565 is invisible here too).
recommendation: Wire the KioskApp syncCb / startAutoSync onSync result into the active waiting screen: on replay success, swap the synthetic offline_ id for the real order id + queue number and resume the normal preparing/ready flow; on abandon (MAX_ATTEMPTS), show an explicit 'commande non envoyée — voyez la caisse' error state. NOTE: fix lands in frozen KioskWaitingComponent/KioskAppComponent → owner gate per §7.
abuse_condition: network drops at the instant of borne checkout, then returns — order syncs but the customer's screen never reflects it

title: Web order-status component is fully static: no Echo, no poll — customer must reload to see status change
anchor: resources/js/components/frontend/components/OrderStatusComponent.vue (158 lines, props-driven only: no mounted/created, no setInterval, no Echo, no axios — verified by grep returning empty)
evidence: OrderStatusComponent renders status purely from props.status (lines 2-40) with zero lifecycle/fetch logic; grep for mounted|created|setInterval|Echo|axios|dispatch|poll|onEvents returns nothing. Unlike the kiosk waiting screen (Echo + 15s poll) and OSS (5s poll), the web/account order-status surface receives NO live updates — a customer on this page sees a frozen status until manual reload. This is OUT of the V1 in-store daily path (borne + counter), hence daily_path=false and P3, but it is a perceived-sync inconsistency if web ordering is ever surfaced.
recommendation: Out of V1 scope (web ordering is not the in-store path). If/when web ordering goes live, mirror the kiosk waiting pattern (Echo branch subscription + low-frequency poll fallback). No action needed for the V1 LOCAL Le Cayenne envelope.
abuse_condition: customer leaves the web status page open expecting it to update — it never does without reload

surface: All push-driven boards (KDS, OSS, POS tracker, kiosk waiting)
title: Every Echo event triggers a full list re-fetch (fetchOrders/list/_doPoll) → request fan-out + re-render churn on order bursts
anchor: resources/js/components/admin/pos/PosOrdersTrackerComponent.vue:692,702,705 (OrderCreated/OrderStatusChanged/OrderPaidAtCounter all → fetchOrders()) ; resources/js/components/admin/orderStatusScreen/PreparingAndReadyComponent.vue:294,299 (all → this.list()) ; resources/js/components/frontend/kiosk/KioskWaitingComponent.vue:288 (OrderStatusChanged → _doPoll())
evidence: The realtime payload (canonical KdsOrder, SYNC_CONTRACT §4) is delivered on the wire but consumers IGNORE it for state and instead fire a full authoritative re-fetch on every event. KioskWaiting guards overlap (_pollInFlight, :326) but the board components do not visibly debounce. During a rush (rapid double-tap bump, 999-quantity batch, several orders placed back-to-back) every order's status transition broadcasts to all subscribed boards, each issuing a fresh GET + full-list re-render → flicker/jank and N requests where 1 delta would do. This is correctness-SAFE (re-fetch reads true current state, so it actually protects against out-of-order events / double-count — not a data bug) but a perceived-smoothness and load cost.
recommendation: Debounce/coalesce the re-fetch (e.g. trailing 250-500ms) so a burst of events collapses into one fetch, and/or apply the already-broadcast payload delta directly when present (the version-gating in KdsSyncService.js:175-187 shows the pattern exists) to avoid full-list re-render flicker. Keep the periodic full-fetch as the reconciliation safety net.
abuse_condition: rush hour: many near-simultaneous status transitions → board flicker and redundant request fan-out

surface: Outbox / queue-worker degradation (affects KDS, OSS, POS, kiosk feeds)
title: Worker-death degradation alert is Log::error + non-zero exit only — no operator-visible signal that everything dropped to slow polling
anchor: app/Console/Commands/MonitorOutboxStaleness.php:35 (description: 'raise an alert (Log::error + non-zero exit)') + :104-118 (context array logged) ; SYNC_CONTRACT.md:49 ('MonitorOutboxStaleness detects (but only Log::error — alerting gap)')
evidence: When queue:work dies, broadcasts stop and all boards silently fall back to polling (SYNC_CONTRACT §7). MonitorOutboxStaleness is the detector, but its only output is Log::error + a non-zero CLI exit code — there is no channel that reaches a human at the counter. On a single-box install with no paging/monitoring stack wired, a dead worker means every surface runs in slow-poll degraded mode indefinitely with nobody told. Compounds finding #1/#2: the boards don't show the degraded banner on the box AND the backend alert goes to a log file no operator reads.
recommendation: Out-of-scope cloud-monitoring aside, give the LOCAL box a lightweight operator-visible signal: expose outbox-staleness state to the admin SPA (a small health pill) or have the monitor write a flag the front-end health-probe already polls, so a stuck pipeline becomes visible on at least the POS/admin shell. Pairs with making the front-end degraded banners fail-safe-to-visible (#1/#2).
abuse_condition: queue:work crashes or is never started after a reboot — silent slow-poll mode with no human notified

title: Unauthenticated OSS public endpoint echoes raw $exception->getMessage() in its 422 body
anchor: app/Http/Controllers/Admin/OrderStatusScreenController.php:103 (publicIndex) and :138 (publicMostPopularItems)
evidence: publicIndex()/publicMostPopularItems() are mounted under the public 'frontend' group (routes/api.php:1288-1293, no auth:sanctum) and their catch blocks do `return response(['status'=>false,'message'=>$exception->getMessage()],422)`. Any client (curl, customer device on LAN) hitting GET /api/frontend/oss-order can trigger and read internal error text — a DB/driver exception message would surface SQL fragments, table names, or stack hints to an unauthenticated caller. The authed siblings (index/mostPopularItems, :36/:47) share the pattern but are behind permission:order-status-screen; the public pair is the exposed one. Throttle:oss-public limits volume but not disclosure.

title: Kiosk machine password embedded plaintext in page DOM when APP_ENV=local (IP-allowlist bypass)
anchor: config/kiosk.php:139 (auto_login_local_bypass => env('APP_ENV')==='local') + resources/views/master.blade.php:121-127 + config/kiosk.php:171-187 (spa_payload = {username, password})
evidence: master.blade.php gates the kioskAutoLogin payload by IP allowlist OR $localBypass. $localBypass = config('kiosk.auto_login_local_bypass') which DEFAULTS to env('APP_ENV')==='local' (config/kiosk.php:139). spa_payload carries the real KIOSK_MACHINE_USERNAME/KIOSK_MACHINE_PASSWORD (falls back to 'kiosk-lecayenne'/'kiosk123', config/kiosk.php:179-186). So IF the Le Cayenne box runs APP_ENV=local (common on a single-box self-host), the IP allowlist is bypassed and ANY LAN device hitting /kiosk* receives the machine username+password in window.foodkingConfig.kioskAutoLogin — view-source / DevTools reads it in cleartext, then mints a kiosk:order Sanctum token. The earlier P0 leak heal (PR-B) reduced this but left APP_ENV=local as a blanket bypass. Severity hinges on the deployed APP_ENV, which is not visible from code.
recommendation: Do NOT tie the credential bypass to APP_ENV. Require KIOSK_AUTO_LOGIN_TRUSTED_IPS (explicit LAN IPs of the physical bornes) for the payload to render in ALL envs, or set KIOSK_REQUIRE_MACHINE_LOGIN=true (UI login form). Confirm the production/box .env is NOT APP_ENV=local and that the default machine password 'kiosk123' is rotated.

surface: Admin shell (all permission-gated SPA routes; e.g. /admin/cash-overview, /admin/sales-report)
title: SPA route guard fails OPEN when meta.access is undefined — low-priv operator mounts admin shells
anchor: resources/js/router/index.js:258-265 (guard only blocks when to.meta.access===false; else next()) + services/appService.js:162-186 (recursiveRouter only sets meta.access for permissionUrls present in the user's list)
evidence: recursiveRouter stamps meta.access ONLY when the route's permissionUrl matches an entry in the user's authPermission array. A Chef (perms = kitchen-display-system, order-status-screen — RolePermissionTableSeeder:115-118) navigating to /admin/cash-overview (permissionUrl 'cash-sessions-report', NOT in their list) never gets meta.access set, so to.meta.access===false is false → the guard's else-branch calls next() and the component MOUNTS. Backend remains authoritative — CashOverviewController:84 abort_unless($user->can('cash-sessions-report'),403), SalesReportController:40 permission:sales-report — so the data fetch 403s and the operator sees an EMPTY/error admin shell, not real money. Felt impact: a low-priv operator can reach admin page shells the nav shouldn't expose (confusing, looks like a leak, surfaces internal layout). The index.js:80 helper even documents the fail-open ('backend reste l'autorité finale via 403'). Defense-in-depth gap, not a data leak — confirmed by checking every mountable daily-path-adjacent controller carries its own guard.
recommendation: In the guard, treat meta.permissionUrl present + meta.access !== true as denied (block when access is undefined for routes that declare a permissionUrl), so an operator can't mount a shell for a permission they don't hold. Keep the redirect+toast from handlePermissionDenied.

title: Customer name + loyalty code + point balance held in kiosk in-memory Vuex; cleared only by RESET, no confirmed idle-timeout reset
anchor: app/Http/Controllers/Frontend/LoyaltyController.php check() returns data.name=$user->name (line ~40) → KioskLoyaltyComponent.vue:495-497 (this.customer = {...data}) → :516/:523 setLoyalty({customer}) → store/modules/kioskCart.js:343 SET_LOYALTY (state.loyaltyCustomer=customer); cleared only at kioskCart.js:411 RESET
evidence: The loyalty lookup response spreads wholesale into this.customer (KioskLoyaltyComponent.vue:495 `this.customer = { ...data, loyalty_point }`) and that object — which the backend populates with `name` (LoyaltyController check data.name=$user->name), `points`, `loyalty_code`, `discount_value` — is committed to Vuex loyaltyCustomer via setLoyalty. So after one customer's loyalty lookup, their real name + loyalty code + point balance sit in the borne's in-memory store. It is NOT persisted to localStorage (good), and kioskCart RESET nulls loyaltyCustomer — but a grep of KioskIdleScreenComponent.vue and KioskAppComponent.vue for an inactivity/idle-timeout dispatch of kioskCart/RESET returned nothing in the idle component. If an abandoned session returns to idle WITHOUT firing RESET, the next customer's session starts with the prior customer's name/code reachable via Vue DevTools / a re-entered flow. Bounded (in-memory only, single-restaurant), but it is PII on a shared public device.
recommendation: Ensure the idle return-to-start (and any abandonment/timeout path back to /kiosk/idle) dispatches kioskCart/RESET so loyaltyCustomer is cleared between customers. Alternatively store only loyalty_code + points in Vuex and drop `name` from the kiosk check() payload (the borne never displays the name).
